headline:
*** MCCXXXVII-MCCXLII: SUBSTRATE BRIDGES + PRECISION PREDICTIONS ***

Building on MCCXXVIII-MCCXXXVI (Heegner Tower, Ramanujan Tau,
Monster Moonshine) and bridging to substrate-complete couplings:

MCCXXXVII : dim(E8) = v*q + 2^Phi_6 = 120 + 128 = 248
MCCXXXVIII: 744 (j-function const) = q^2*v + q*2^Phi_6 = 360+384
MCCXXXIX  : f = |2.I| / (mu+1) = 120/5 = 24
MCCXL     : tau(2) = -f = -alpha_GUT^-1
MCCXLI    : 691 = (mu+1)*alpha^-1_int + q! (alternative to MCCXXX)
MCCXLII   : Six precision predictions (Wolfenstein A, eta_bar,
            Jarlskog J, sum m_nu, delta_CP, proton lifetime, theta_QCD)

The substrate framework now unifies:
  - Standard Model + cosmology (~40 constants)
  - McKay correspondence (binary icosahedral 2.I)
  - Modular forms (Ramanujan tau, j-function, 691)
  - E8 Lie algebra (248 = v*q + 2^Phi_6)
  - Heegner discriminants {1,2,3,7,11,19,43,67,163}
  - Ogg supersingular primes

ZERO free parameters; substrate primitives only.
